system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

By mastering the Tiger Stance, you become a fierce and powerful combatant. Your attacks inflict slashing damage. Any bleed damage that you inflict whilst in this stance is increased by 1.

As long as your Speed is at least 20 feet while in Tiger Stance, you can Step 10 feet.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: your unarmed attacks (fists, gauntlets, Monastic weapons) deal slashing damage, without asking (Graham's B6-1); bleeding you inflict is increased by 1; and while your Speed is at least 20 feet your Step is 10 feet.
